+| `PAY-005` | Failed-payment retries and notices | target | partial | `tests/platter.test.mjs` — “deposit signatures survive declines, required acceptance waits for Stripe success and due acceptance stays complete”; `tests/collection-journey.mjs` — “failureNoticesJourney”; `tests/mail.test.mjs` — “PAY-005 confirmed deposit attempts notify both parties once and hold revoked, obsolete, uncertain or interrupted mail without replay”; `tests/site.test.mjs` and `tests/collection-browser.mjs` — “deposit collection settings, retained signatures, required and due completion at desktop and phone widths”; `tests/archive.test.mjs` — “APPROVE-002 / AUTO-003 / FOLLOW-003 public CLI retains notification business history without credentials, queued messages or restored outbound authority” | Delivered: Explicit owner consent enables once-only client and owner notices for ordinary mailbox-verified, tax-free USD single-client deposits. A provider-read failed charge must identify the current account, accepted revision, exact authorized amount and attempt. Initial payment-method status, browser claims and ambiguous responses notify nobody. Allowlisted reasons and delivery outcomes survive restore; current authority and invitation are rechecked before dispatch, confirmed payment suppresses obsolete notices, and uncertain mail never replays. Interrupted in-flight notice sends become held history without provider replay. Missing: Milestone and recurring failures, owner-set retry schedules, future-charge authorization, automatic retries, cancellation after offline payment, SMS, other processors and live-provider qualification. Conservative owner-only authority remains the standing interim floor; configured-recipient execution remains omitted. Existing SEND-003 and SIGN-004 judgment holds and PAY-001, PAY-002, PAY-003, PAY-004 and PAY-008 real-key holds remain unchanged. |
 | `PAY-006` | Refunds and disputes | target | partial | `src/platter/payments.ts`, `tests/platter.test.mjs`, `tests/site.test.mjs`, `tests/archive.test.mjs` | Verified Stripe refunds retain reasons, idempotent bounds and uncertain holds. Dispute preparation, exact packet authorization, explicit once-only submission and Stripe receipt remain distinct (RL-4). Missing: accounting credits; full SIGN-005 certificates and attachments, TRACK-001 views and PAY-001/PAY-002 authorization artifacts in the evidence pack; company-policy execution within the agent sponsor’s financial role and grant. Uncertain refunds and submissions require provider reconciliation. |
 | `PAY-007` | Check, wire and ACH credit payments | target | partial | `src/platter/payments.ts`, `tests/platter.test.mjs`, `tests/site.test.mjs`, `tests/archive.test.mjs` | Owner, admin and billing record received check, wire and ACH credit payments with reference and receipt date; tests/platter.test.mjs — “TEAM-001 billing records received payments and refunds a verified Stripe deposit; sales cannot call Stripe and retries or uncertain outcomes cannot double refund” proves the role boundary and all three methods. The role archive journey preserves exact records. Gap: milestone and schedule reconciliation, accounting synchronization, remittance details and overdue removal. |
